## Historical ticket scope — superseded where conflicting

Preserved below for release/intent provenance. July wrapper/GF/optional-daemon/build.zig.zon execution instructions are not actionable current authority.

## What

Split from TIN-1830 per operator decision 2026-07-09 (see closing comment there). Service residency itself is PROVEN (#444, `docs/evidence/keepalive-service-residency-20260704T161515Z/`, shipped v0.1.14); this ticket is the operability tail.

## Acceptance

* `doctor` reports the resident service binary's version + SHA and the PATH-resolved binary's version + SHA, side by side.
* Warn when the resident binary is older than the installed binary (offline-safe compare; sibling of TIN-2463's `version --check`).
* PATH-shadow detection: multiple `oauth-mux` on PATH → report all, state which wins (the 2026-07-04→07 shadow on neo was live-observed; currently benign, mechanism persists).
* systemd-user leg proven on a Linux host with a dated `docs/evidence/` dir.
* Remote lanes green before any completion claim.

## Priority note

High because managed broker work is active. The relevant lineage is the authenticated per-session Claude sidecar (TIN-1829) and same-process handoff proof (TIN-2077), not canceled TIN-2721 canonical-keychain mutation. A stale resident can still provide incorrect refresh/observation state to managed sessions even though it does not own the sidecar request path.

## Current host gate (2026-07-13)

The macOS upgrade/restart dogfood is paused on TIN-1759. The shared GUI launchd domain still exposes direct secret-bearing variables; narrow and activate that host policy before restarting the service, then capture minimal-environment and `stale=false` evidence. This is a host custody dependency, not an oauth-mux binary Gate the managed Claude proxy on measured product performance and exact-once correctness, not micro-optimization claims.

## Required budgets

* Local routing/auth overhead before upstream I/O: p95 <= 5 ms, p99 <= 10 ms.
* Sustained SSE throughput: within 5% of direct Claude Code.
* Idle sidecar RSS: <= 20 MiB.
* No starvation at 20 concurrent managed sessions across 50 enrolled accounts.
* Replay memory: 32 MiB/request, 64 MiB/sidecar, 256 MiB/host. Use atomic cross-process reservations with stale-PID cleanup.
* Missing reservation or chunked/unknown-length overflow degrades to stream-once with backpressure; never disk spool.

## Correctness

At most two upstream attempts. Only explicit pre-body 401/403/429 can select one alternate. Provider 5xx passes through. Ambiguous transport, cancellation, partial writes, and started responses never cross accounts. Health/state writes must be atomic and state-change-bounded.

Persistent HTTP clients, buffered header parsing, and parse/write deduplication are implementation tools only when measurement justifies them; do not buffer successful SSE bodies.

## Acceptance

A deterministic fake Anthropic upstream plus a direct-vs-proxy benchmark publishes redacted artifacts for latency percentiles, throughput, RSS, memory-pressure fallback, stale reservation cleanup, attempt counts, and 20x50 lock fairness.
